 Elderly women and children survive Russian attack on Kharkiv
 A Russian drone attack in Ukraine’s Kharkiv late Tuesday forced elderly women and children to evacuate their homes. Firefighters were seen leading a disabled woman to safety as houses and industrial buildings were destroyed by fire.
